title: 逆行人群
desc: 主角转身，走进一整片整齐的人群。上传一张角色图，主角就换成你的角色。
note: 内部测试：原片来自网络，不可对外发布
who: the young man with very short blond hair in the white shirt and loose striped tie

slot.label: 主角
slot.hint: 上传一张人物图，全身照或带服装的图效果最好

fill.new_person: the character from @image2, with the same face, hair and body, wearing the white shirt and loose striped tie

slot.framePrompt: Photo retouch. Keep the photograph @image1 exactly as it is: same framing, same crowd of students in dark blazers behind, same light, focus and grain. Only the person in the front changes: instead of the young blond man it is the character from @image2, same face, hair and features as in @image2, at the same size and position, wearing exactly the same white shirt and loose striped tie. Lit by the same soft daylight. It must look photographed, not pasted on. No text, no letters, no logos.

modes.label: 换整个人（含衣服）
modes.hint: 脸、发型、身材、衣服、配饰都换成你图里的样子，动作和走位照原片
modes.framePrompt: Photo retouch. Keep the photograph @image1 exactly as it is: same framing, same crowd of students in dark blazers behind, same light, focus and grain. Only the person in the front changes: replace them completely with the person from @image2 — the same face, hair, body, clothes, shoes and accessories as in @image2, nothing kept from the original person's outfit — at the same size and position in the frame, in the same pose, head angle and expression as the person in @image1. Lit by the same soft daylight. @image2 may be a character sheet (a face close-up plus front, side and back views): it is all one single person, use it only to know what they look like; put exactly one of them in the shot. It must look photographed, not pasted on. No text, no letters, no logos.

modes.label: 只换脸，保留原片衣服
modes.hint: 只换脸和发型，衣服沿用原片的白衬衫和领带
